prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, over-the-shoulder shot of a person holding a smartphone in their right hand, with the screen facing the camera. The phone has a red case and displays an online shopping website featuring a product page for a black, adjustable TV stand. The person is wearing a red sweater, and only the back of their head and shoulder are visible, slightly out of focus, drawing attention to the phone screen. The background is softly blurred, suggesting an indoor, modern environment with glass and metal elements, possibly an office or a store. The lighting is natural and even, creating a clean, contemporary atmosphere. The color palette is dominated by muted grays and reds, with the phone screen providing a bright focal point. The composition uses shallow depth of field to emphasize the act of online shopping, capturing a candid, everyday moment with a sense of immediacy and realism.
